items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: It had, uh, Jack Carey. Oh, yeah. Jack Carey was a trombone player. Georgia Boy on clarinet, Walter Preston on banjo.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was in Punch's band then?
Yeah. It had, uh, Jack Carey. Oh, yeah. Jack Carey was a trombone player. Georgia Boy on clarinet, Walter Preston on banjo.
Did you play second trumpet or were you playing bass then?
